statuses.verified-flow: strict assertions passed against the bound serving consumer, exit 0
statuses.reused: verified live instance with the same selection reused and left running, exit 0
statuses.refused-verified: entry refused exactly the requested selection mismatch, exit 0
statuses.observed: --observe only, no assertions and verified=false; never acceptance, exit 0
statuses.NOT_REACHED: selected package lacks the capability, exit 4, no checkout fallback

driverProtocol.migration: wave22 status:ok is removed; consumers must read status/verified

strictResults.v1Source: verified-flow, identity bound, record pid = spawned pid, cleanup stopped
strictResults.v2Source: verified-flow through the same standard entry with its own root and consent
strictResults.observed: status observed, verified false, assertions [], actual chat still 422

driverLevel: /usr/bin/true start entry -> entry_exited, mock ready service not accepted
hanging entry -> readiness_timeout and owned child stopped

consumerBinding.identityFunction: package's own restoredReviewIdentity in a child process
consumerBinding.fresh: record pid equals spawned entry pid, record digest equals requested digest, mode personal, api port matches, process alive, health digest matches
consumerBinding.reused: entry exit 0 plus the same record digest, alive original pid (!= spawned pid) and matching health digest
refusals: different valid narrow selection -> refused-verified, original pid unchanged
ready foreign port without record -> entry_exited failure
consumerBinding.missingSelection: covered by retained wave21 standard-start reuse/refusal test

dialects.packageStart: NOT_REACHED exit 4 with release_missing/first_run_required family on this source checkout; entries point to pa and no fallback occurred

mapping.context binding/frozen body: history entry, sources verified, audit bundleDigest unchanged

sameStoreFlow.formats: default workflow-snapshot/1 and explicit workflow-snapshot/2 each restored to its own root and reviewed through the source standard entry

retained: narrow selection starts but scope_changed hides content
cost: no readable-count scan or cross-await transaction

layerBoundaries.package: package review entry reached; package start NOT_REACHED without release/first-run
layerBoundaries.installed: not claimed; E must bind entry SHA and package subject
